assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: a transparent food selection sticker for the Super Nutrition mobile app.
Primary request: one recognizable ripe yellow banana, partly peeled so the cream fruit and folded yellow peel are visible. This is an individual food icon, not a sheet.
Style/medium: realistic crisp product photograph, natural food texture and subtle soft studio light. Match the visual language of small photorealistic food cutout stickers: a clean thin white die-cut outline follows the complete banana silhouette.
Composition/framing: banana gently curves from lower left to upper right, centered on a square transparent canvas, entire fruit and peel visible with modest even padding; subject fills around 80% of image. No plate or table.
Color palette: natural yellow peel, cream banana, tiny natural brown stem.
Constraints: real transparent alpha background; white outline only around the food; no shadow/background slab, no other food, no green backing, no text, faces, checkmarks, badges, labels, watermarks or UI.
